objective: SAXPY y[i] = a*x[i] + y[i] over fp32 must match the CPU reference within atol 1e-6 on the typical, zero_block and tail data sets, at a device time the bench actually measured.

groups.name: typical
groups.intent: random fp32 in [-1, 1) for x and y, a=2.5; the ordinary data path

groups.name: zero_block
groups.intent: a quarter of x is exactly zero with y non-zero; fails a zero-input fast path that stores zero instead of leaving y

groups.name: tail
groups.intent: N+37 elements, so the last partial 256-thread block is exercised
